panels.description: The Caldera representative submits a polished allocation proposal with a clean diagram. Keep upper proposal clear.
The House diagram visibly omits the Keel residential branch while retaining industrial delivery. Keep upper diagram clear.
Tomas places the old public baseline beside the House diagram and clips a physical gauge to the pipe. Keep upper comparison clear.
Keel workers compare the gauge, Measure and House proposal at the public table; use indistinct background bodies only. Keep upper table clear.

items.speaker: TOMAS
items.text: You counted the pipe after you stopped counting the homes.
